description: This source file defines a set of tools for managing GitHub Actions workflows, including listing, running, retrieving details, logs, rerunning, canceling, and managing artifacts for workflows and workflow runs. It interfaces with the GitHub API via the go-github client and provides structured schemas and functions for each operation.

methods.name: ListWorkflows
methods.description: Creates a tool to list workflows in a repository

methods.name: ListWorkflowRuns
methods.description: Creates a tool to list workflow runs for a specific workflow

methods.name: RunWorkflow
methods.description: Creates a tool to run an Actions workflow by workflow ID or filename

methods.name: GetWorkflowRun
methods.description: Creates a tool to get details of a specific workflow run

methods.name: GetWorkflowRunLogs
methods.description: Creates a tool to download logs for a specific workflow run

methods.name: ListWorkflowJobs
methods.description: Creates a tool to list jobs for a specific workflow run

methods.name: GetJobLogs
methods.description: Creates a tool to download logs for a specific workflow job or get failed job logs for a run

methods.name: RerunWorkflowRun
methods.description: Creates a tool to re-run an entire workflow run

methods.name: RerunFailedJobs
methods.description: Creates a tool to re-run only the failed jobs in a workflow run

methods.name: CancelWorkflowRun
methods.description: Creates a tool to cancel a workflow run

methods.name: ListWorkflowRunArtifacts
methods.description: Creates a tool to list artifacts for a workflow run

methods.name: DownloadWorkflowRunArtifact
methods.description: Creates a tool to download a workflow run artifact

methods.name: DeleteWorkflowRunLogs
methods.description: Creates a tool to delete logs for a workflow run

methods.name: GetWorkflowRunUsage
methods.description: Creates a tool to get usage metrics for a workflow run
